reviews.title: Always unable to connect
reviews.text:
I am a user of VPN cat. I purchased the high-speed server in the beginning of this year. Everything goes well at first. Unfortunately, I have noticed that there is often a problem when I try to connect VPN these months. It always shows the sign “Unable to connect to the VPN server. Please try again or choose another country.” Then I tried to choose another country for many times, but it still didn’t work.

I thought it might be my problem instead of your app, so I downloaded other VPN apps and I succeeded to connect VPN with their apps. Therefore, it was your app’s problem. 

I purchased the high-speed server for a year, but I am unable to enjoy it. Please fix this problem for me. Otherwise, I will request a refund. Thank you.
